entries.description: A careless movement or sudden noise brings danger.
Your thorough inspection uncovers an environmental threat.
Discarded rations, spent torch stubs, or faint carvings give insight into who passed here.
Nothing of interest or value is found despite careful scrutiny.
A scrawled note, scratch marks, or draft hints at the layout ahead.
A few loose coins, a polished gem, or useful adventuring salvage.
A hollow brick concealing a minor niche, or an old mechanism lever.
You uncover a hidden way forward!
